descriptionHtml: INNOVATORS 2019 is organized by the innovators club of University of Peradeniya in colloboration with IEEE student branch. This event is organized for first year students. The participants were divided into groups and they have to design and implement a given design within the given time. Designs are very simple things like innovative hearth(wood), walking robot with small dc motor, mini airplane (gliding), water rockets e.t.c. Few teams work on same design with different approaches and most efficient team wins. However they have to complete their task with given resources.
